obligation: NIST CSF 2.0 with NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3: Crude Oil Production
basis: No binding federal sector cybersecurity rule reaches an onshore producer (N21-R01 to N21-R03 below; Part 195 excepts production facilities). The 2025 group policies are aligned to CSF 2.0, so the group benchmarks the division against all 106 subcategories

obligation: USCG Cybersecurity in the Marine Transportation System: all divisions and group
basis: 101.605(a) reaches owners and operators of vessels, facilities and OCS facilities that need security plans under 33 CFR parts 104 to 106. All wells, plants, pipelines and terminals are onshore; no vessel, waterfront facility or OCS facility is listed

obligation: TSA pipeline Security Directives (also N22-R02 and N48-49-R03): Crude Logistics
basis: The directives apply to pipeline owners and operators that TSA has notified are critical. The division operates a trunk line and gathering lines, so a notice is possible; none has been received

obligation: TSA pipeline Security Directives: Production, Power Generation and group
basis: Production flow lines and facility piping are production facilities, and Power Generation and corporate operate no pipelines

obligation: CIRCIA proposed rule: all divisions and group
basis: Not a final rule. As proposed, 226.2 would cover the group: 45,000 employees exceeds the 1,250-employee SBA standard for NAICS 211120 (13 CFR 121.201)

obligation: SPCC high-level alarm option: Crude Oil Production
basis: About 250 of the 410 central tank batteries meet the overfill rule with high-level sensors whose alarms are transmitted to the field SCADA

obligation: SPCC production container rule: Power Generation and Crude Logistics
basis: 112.9 covers onshore oil production facilities. The plants are not production facilities, and the Crude Logistics breakout tanks are regulated under Part 195

obligation: Oil discharge notice to the National Response Center: all divisions
basis: Each division stores or moves oil (tank batteries and flow lines; plant fuel and lube oil; pipelines and trucks); a discharge that may be harmful must be reported immediately

obligation: NERC CIP-002-5.1a and CIP-003-9 (low impact): Power Generation
basis: Registered Generator Owner and Generator Operator. The largest plant (640 MW) and the GCC (1,180 MW) are below the 1,500 MW bright lines and no planner designation exists, so P1, P2, P3 and the GCC contain low impact BES Cyber Systems only. CIP-003-9 Attachment 1 Section 6 is in force from 2026-04-01

obligation: NERC CIP-012-2: Power Generation
basis: The GCC is a Generator Operator Control Center that sends real-time data to Balancing Authority and market operator Control Centers; enforceable from 2026-07-01

obligation: NERC EOP-004-4 event reporting: Power Generation
basis: Applies to Generator Owners and Generator Operators

obligation: NERC CIP-004 to CIP-011, CIP-013 and CIP-014: Power Generation
basis: These apply to high and medium impact BES Cyber Systems or to Transmission Owners and Operators; the division has low impact systems only and is registered only as GO and GOP

obligation: NERC CIP and EOP-004: Production, Crude Logistics and group
basis: No NERC registration and no BES assets outside the Power Generation division

obligation: Form DOE-417 electric emergency report: Power Generation
basis: The division is not a Balancing Authority, Reliability Coordinator or electric utility, and none of its generation is dedicated to end-use customers; its output is sold in wholesale markets

obligation: NRC power reactor cyber security rule: Power Generation
basis: The division's three plants are natural gas-fired; no nuclear unit or NRC license is recorded

obligation: SDWA risk and resilience assessment: all divisions
basis: The group operates no community water system; produced water is injected or disposed in wells, not supplied as drinking water

obligation: PHMSA 49 CFR Part 195 (control room management, reporting, gathering line classes): Crude Logistics
basis: The 140-mile, 16-inch intrastate trunk line is larger than 8 5/8 inch, so it is a regulated pipeline in full, and its PCC and backup PCC are control rooms under 195.446. 120 miles of gathering lines are regulated rural gathering lines (195.11) and about 2,180 miles are reporting-regulated-only (195.15)

obligation: PHMSA 49 CFR Part 195: Production, Power Generation and group
basis: Onshore production facilities and flow lines are excepted, so the IOC, BCC and Florida control room are not pipeline control rooms; Power Generation and corporate operate no hazardous liquid pipelines

obligation: Hazmat transportation security plans and training: Crude Logistics
basis: About 1,150 cargo tanks of about 8,400 gallons carry UN1267 in Packing Group I or II, a large bulk quantity of Class 3 material (172.800(b)(6))

obligation: Hazmat transportation security plans: Production, Power Generation and group
basis: Crude leaves Production leases by pipeline or in Crude Logistics trucks; the other divisions do not offer or carry hazmat in plan quantities

obligation: Hazmat incident reports: Crude Logistics
basis: The division carries hazardous materials in commerce

obligation: ELD and driver harassment rules: Crude Logistics
basis: About 1,150 trucks use ELDs in the same telematics platform as the driver-facing cameras

obligation: Federal anti-discrimination laws for employment decisions (for example, Title VII and the ADA): Crude Logistics driver discipline
basis: Camera AI scores feed driver discipline for about 3,900 drivers; these laws apply to employment decisions however they are made

obligation: State biometric privacy laws: Crude Logistics driver cameras
basis: They apply only if the vendor uses face geometry to identify drivers; counsel is confirming the vendor's method for each state of operation

obligation: USCG MTSA cyber rule (transportation listing; same rule as N21-R01): Crude Logistics
basis: No vessel, MTSA facility or waterfront terminal; the trunk line delivers to an inland market hub

obligation: TSA rail and public transportation Security Directives: Crude Logistics
basis: The division operates trucks and pipelines, not railroads or transit

obligation: TSA aviation security programs: Crude Logistics
basis: No airport or aircraft operations are recorded

obligation: CTPAT (voluntary): Crude Logistics
basis: Voluntary program for carriers in international supply chains; crude hauling runs between leases and terminals in Texas, New Mexico and Oklahoma, and no CTPAT participation is recorded

obligation: DOT unfair or deceptive practices (airlines and ticket agents): Crude Logistics
basis: Not an air carrier or ticket agent

obligation: CMMC Program: all divisions
basis: The contract register shows no DoD or other federal contracts or subcontracts

obligation: FAR safeguarding and covered-article clauses: all divisions
basis: The contract register shows no federal contracts or subcontracts

obligation: SEC cybersecurity disclosure: group
basis: The holding company is an SEC registrant; divisions contribute incident facts through the group, and the FY2025 annual report carries the Item 106 disclosure

obligation: Florida Information Protection Act (worked example of state breach laws): all divisions
basis: The group holds personal information of about 21,000 Florida royalty owners (Social Security or taxpayer numbers, bank accounts) and of Florida employees

obligation: Other states' breach notification laws: all divisions
basis: Royalty owners live in all 50 states and employees in 4 states; the law of each state where affected individuals reside applies

obligation: OFAC sanctions on ransomware payments: group
basis: Applies to all U.S. persons, including any ransom decision

obligation: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard: all divisions
basis: No payment card acceptance agreement is recorded; revenue is crude, gas, power and transportation sales

obligation: BSEE offshore rules: Crude Oil Production
basis: No offshore or OCS operations

obligation: MSHA mine safety rules: Crude Oil Production
basis: MSHA issues no cybersecurity rules, and the division operates oil wells, not mines

obligation: Sensitive Security Information: all divisions
basis: No MTSA facility and no TSA-notified pipeline, so no SSI is held

obligation: Shipper transportation contracts and SOC 2 requests: Crude Logistics
basis: The contracts set statement dates and dispute windows; the three largest shippers asked for a SOC 2 Type 2 report by the end of 2027. Production and Power Generation provide no service that other organizations rely on for their controls

obligation: Intercompany transportation and data agreement: Production and Crude Logistics
basis: Covers LACT custody volumes and electronic run tickets sent to the FSPA

obligation: Joint operating agreements: Crude Oil Production
citation: Operating agreements with about 2,600 non-operating working interest owners
basis: Partners audit joint interest billing under the audit clauses; material changes in operating practice are reported as the agreements require

obligation: Cyber insurance policy conditions: group
basis: The tower provides a breach hotline and panel firms; the insurer is called on Day 0 of an incident
